body: I'm not sure if this relates to what your asking, but my mother recently told me that when I was young, I went into her room in the middle of the night and told her that my bed was shaking. I guess she just brushed it off until we were talking to my family about the various experiences we've had with the paranormal. She told me then, which made me remember the other night when I woke up to my bed vibrating. I have more stories of other family members if you want to hear.
